title: The restricted augmented lift computes the cohomology h-map
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S′\to S$ be scheme morphisms, $F$ a module sheaf on $X$, $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $J$ an injective resolution of $(g′)^*F$, and $t:I\to g′_*J$ a complex map lifting the tensor-adjunction unit, with $g′$ the second pullback projection. For every $p\ge0$, open $V\subset S$ and choices $D:FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices(f,g,F,I,J,V)$, the constructed flatBaseChangeResolutionOpenMap equals moduleCohomologyFMap of the restricted projection h on $g′^{-1}(f^{-1}V)$ with map D.psi. No flatness is needed. The constructions are [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-open-map], [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], and [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap].

proof.text: Restrict t to U. Conjugate with the augmentation-preserving comparison isomorphisms D.source.comparison and D.target.comparison and the restriction/direct-image comparison. Their augmentation identities and D.unit_square give a map from the restricted source resolution into h_* of the restricted target resolution, with augmentation D.psi.

Replace the pushed target complex by a complex of injectives using [lem-weil-pbc-complex-injective-resolution-mono], extending by zero and truncating to natural indices as in the construction [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. Take lambda composed with the restricted lift for the horizontal map in ModuleCohomologyFMapData. Sections of lambda are a quasi-isomorphism by [lem-weil-pbc-module-pushforward-injectives-sections-quasi-iso]. The formula defining the cohomology map cancels its homology map against its inverse. Independence [lem-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap-functorial] compares this choice with the recorded moduleCohomologyFMap.

D.source.components and D.target.components identify the maps on section complexes degreewise with restriction of t. The sectionwise pushforward square in flatBaseChangeResolutionQ and flatBaseChangeOpenEquality identify their codomain with sections of f′_*J on g^{-1}V. After cancelling lambda the remaining maps are precisely r_S, H(q_V), and r_T.

Compose the equality of section-complex homology maps with the inverse target cohomology comparison. The target comparison cancels and the source and target maps are exactly those defining [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-open-map]. This gives equality with moduleCohomologyFMap as asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem flatBaseChangeRestrictedLift_homology {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (ht : I.ι.f 0 ≫ t.f 0 =
      (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd g f))).unit.app F ≫
        (pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (p : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    flatBaseChangeResolutionOpenMap f g I J t p V D =
      moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi p
